title: CONTRIBUTING described a gate smaller than the one make check runs
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: Read against the Makefile's check target. CONTRIBUTING.md now lists all eight.

details: "`make check` runs the gofmt check, `go vet`, the Go suite, the viewer's JavaScript suite, and the prose linter." The target is `check: fmt-check vet lint deadcode test docs oss`. The three it left out are the two that need an install and the publication linter, which is the one whose warnings a contributor is most likely to meet first.
